summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests MOv19-BBz CAR T cells, which are a patient's own T cells engineered to target folate receptor alpha (FRa), in people with metastatic or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer. Patients receive one dose of the CAR T cells by intrapleural infusion (directly into the chest lining) after lymphodepleting chemotherapy, and checkpoint inhibitors may start at least 28 days later. The study aims to assess safety, feasibility and preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa las células CAR T MOv19-BBz, que son células T propias del paciente modificadas para atacar el receptor de folato alfa (FRa), en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas metastásico o recurrente. Los pacientes reciben una sola dosis de las células CAR T por infusión intrapleural (directamente en la membrana que recubre el pulmón) después de quimioterapia de linfodepleción, y los inhibidores de puntos de control pueden iniciarse al menos 28 días después. El estudio tiene como objetivos evaluar la seguridad, la factibilidad y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Metastatic or recurrent lung adenocarcinoma with a malignant pleural effusion
Failed at least one prior line of standard therapy for advanced disease
Tumor FRa expression of at least 10% by IHC, with archived tumor tissue available
not_for: Pleural effusion that cannot be drained with standard approaches
Significant lung disease, such as lymphangitic spread, radiation pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
Dependence on systemic steroids or immunosuppressant medications
